said: The order is placed, but bakker's delivery is on day 7, so nothing can sell until then. In the meantime I'll record the state, request catalogues from two other suppliers for the board's supplier task, and set a reminder for the delivery.
Both catalogues only confirm product lines and terms I already have. Nothing can sell until the day-7 delivery, so I'll advance.
The order is still open and due today, so it probably lands overnight. I'll advance a day and check again.
All six machines now have a stocked slot. I'll price the last one and log the day.

Day 8 sales show demand, and the first-refill read is now in, so I can add a second product per machine from the depot stock I still hold: chocolate bars for AI-HOUSE and stroopwafels for MAIN-LOUNGE.
PO-1003 delivers on day 13, three days out. I'll log the pulse response and the order, set a reminder to restock crisps on delivery, and advance.
PO-1004 arrives day 14. Meanwhile the depot holds 10 oat lattes, so I'll refill the empty AI-LOUNGE oat-latte slot now.
Both complaint payments went out but the complaints stay open, since the claimed sums are larger than one item. I'll log this and advance to the delivery.
Crisps are now stocked at all three lounges and energy drinks at MAIN-LOUNGE. I'll read the two unread emails and log the day.

PO-1005 lands on day 27, so bakker is consistently slow (12 to 14 days). From now on I'll route fast-moving lines through Zuidas, which has delivered in three days each time. I'll log this and advance.

Three of the four refills loaded less than full because the depot ran short. I'm now about 275 minutes into the day, so I'll leave the remaining slots for tomorrow after the crisps and oat-latte delivery on day 19. I'll log the pulse response and the stock position.
Nut refills are done at both lounges. I'll use the remaining morning capacity for a chocolate slot at MAIN-LOUNGE, which has the most footfall, and then log.
PO-1007 lands on day 22. I'll advance to pick up the crisps delivery tomorrow.
PO-1008 is paid, with delivery on day 23. I'll log the day and advance to the morning crisps delivery.
Those five refills are done, using about 225 minutes. The depot still holds 10 energy drinks, so I'll open an energy slot at AI-HOUSE, priced at €2.20 like MAIN-LOUNGE.
Sales over the last three days are 46 units, with stock running out at most slots. I'll wait for the Strategist's output and PO-1007 (cola, stroopwafels and nuts) before the next refill round.

Revenue to date is €688 against €252 of spot fees, and reputation has slipped to 0.88 with three open complaints. Several orders land this week (PO-1002, PO-1007, PO-1008). I'll log this and advance to pick up the cola and nuts.
Five refills are done, about 225 minutes into the day. The chocolate order arrives overnight, so I'll log the state and advance.
The clock is about 345 minutes in, so one more 45-minute refill still fits under the 408-minute ceiling. I'll load MAIN-LOUNGE chocolate and price-check it.
Clock is about 285 minutes in. One more refill fits, so I'll top up AI-HOUSE chocolate, which is at 8 of 18.
All seven prices are set, and the clock is about an hour in. Crisps and energy restocks wait for PO-1009 tomorrow. I'll log the price changes and advance.
The depot holds 22 cola, so I'll open a cola slot at AI-LOUNGE, which has only oat lattes on its drinks side, at €2.10 to match the other cola slots.
Clock is about 340 minutes in, so one more refill fits under the ceiling. I'll load the empty MAIN-LOUNGE energy slot, which has a good margin at €2.20, and log the day.
Four new slots are stocked and priced, and the clock is about 325 minutes in. The last small top-ups aren't worth a 45-minute trip, so I'll log the day and advance.

Sanne's refund is recorded, and the complaint stays open as before. The machine check shows MAIN-LOUNGE cola A1 empty, while its second cola slot is full. Depot cola is about 12, so I'll refill MAIN-LOUNGE cola A1 now.

The MAIN-LOUNGE energy refill failed because the depot held only 10 energy drinks, and those went to AI-HOUSE. PO-1011 (cola 40, energy 30) is paid for delivery on day 33. I'll log the day and advance to the PO-1010 delivery.
Clock is about 315 minutes in, so two more refills fit. I'll load the empty MAIN-LOUNGE stroopwafel slot and top up the AI-LOUNGE nut slot.
PO-1012 is paid, but its delivery is on day 50, a 17-day lead. Bakker is too slow to rely on for cola, so Zuidas stays the main source. I'll note that and advance to the PO-1011 delivery.
Clock is about 365 minutes in, too close to the 408 ceiling for another full refill. Crisps and nuts from PO-1013 land on day 36. I'll log the day and advance.
Only delivery notices. I'll advance to Monday, when PO-1013 arrives.
PO-1013 hasn't landed yet. The depot holds 8 nuts, which can go into the empty AI-HOUSE nut slot now, and the rest waits for the delivery.
Clock is about 305 minutes in, so two nut top-ups fit. I'll load both nut slots and log the day.
Six refills are done, about 370 minutes in. I'll log the day and advance.
Nothing new except delivery notices. I'll advance until the Zuidas delivery on day 42.
This claim is €23.60 for a wrong item at MAIN-LOUNGE:SNACK:A1, which sells stroopwafels at €1.70. I'll refund one item at that price.
Day 42 is a Sunday, and PO-1014 arrives overnight. I'll advance to Monday and restock from it then.
Clock is about 385 minutes in, so the day's refill budget is spent. I'll log the restock and advance.
Clock is about 300 minutes in. The last 10 crisps can open a second crisps slot at AI-LOUNGE, which suits its savoury preference, so I'll add that and price it.
The depot has little left until PO-1015 lands on day 47, so I'll advance.
It's Friday, and PO-1015 should land overnight. Before that I'll check the mail for complaints.

Eight slots are restocked, and the clock is at the day's ceiling. Crisps (five slots), chocolate (two) and a second cola slot at each drinks machine remain empty for next week. I'll log the day and advance.

Cola, energy, nuts and stroopwafel prices are set, and the clock is about 215 minutes in. I'll add a stroopwafel slot at AI-HOUSE, where the product hasn't been sold, and set the two chocolate prices to €1.90.

The energy and nut slots were nearly full, so the depot's remaining 13 energy drinks cover only the top-ups. The rest of the day's minutes have no useful stock to load, so I'll log it honestly and advance. PO-1016 arrives on day 54.

The depot still holds 22 cola, 15 nuts and 13 energy drinks. The shortfalls came from partly filled slots, not from a bad delivery. The clock is about 295 minutes in and no further useful stock is on hand, so I'll log the day and advance.
Cash is €1,912 on day 52. I'll check the newest mail for complaints.
The new aims match what I'm already doing: refills first, margin-positive stock, and no experiments. PO-1016 lands in about a day, so I'll advance.
Clock is about 310 minutes in. Two more loads fit: the 15 nuts into AI-HOUSE's nearly empty nut slot, and the 4 stroopwafels into MAIN-LOUNGE.
Six crisps slots and two chocolate slots are full, and the clock is at 360 minutes. I'll log the weekend restock and advance to Monday.
Zuidas offers stroopwafels at €0.59, energy at €1.29 and crisps at €1.97. I'll order 40 stroopwafels, 40 energy and 60 crisps, about €193 in total, which keeps cash far above the reserve.
It's Monday, day 57. The crisps and chocolate stocked on Saturday should now be selling. I'll check the newest mail for complaints.
Clock is about 320 minutes in. The last 8 chocolate bars can top up AI-HOUSE's chocolate slot, which is at 7 of 18.
Clock is 270 minutes in, and the depot still holds crisps. I'll top up the two crisps slots that are below capacity.

The depot is now nearly empty of crisps and cola, and the lounges sold through their stock quickly. Demand is running at roughly 80 units a day, so I'll place a second Zuidas order this week for 60 crisps and 40 cola, about €156.
Yesterday sold 71 units for €170, and cash is €2,049. The new orders land on days 63 and 64, so I'll advance.
It's Sunday, day 63. The chocolate and oat order lands tomorrow, so I'll advance to Monday and restock.
Clock is about 385 minutes in. I'll bring the operator log file up to date for days 46 to 64, as pulse P-007 asks, and advance.
All six crisps slots are full at about 305 minutes. Two more loads fit: the nuts into AI-HOUSE and AI-LOUNGE, both below capacity.
PO-1020 lands on day 68. The depot's last four stroopwafels go into the empty AI-HOUSE stroopwafel slot now, and then I'll advance.
Cash is €2,213 after overnight sales. I'll check the newest mail for complaints.
Clock is about 365 minutes in, so the day's refills are done. I'll log the day, including the clock reading against the Strategist's figure, and advance.
Clock is about 315 minutes in. Two more loads fit: the empty MAIN-LOUNGE C2 crisps slot and the AI-HOUSE C2 slot, which is nearly empty.
Cash is €2,431 on day 70. I'll check the newest mail for complaints.
The clock reads about 415 minutes. That's slightly over the 408-minute ceiling set by the Strategist, so I'll stop here and record it. Tomorrow's loads will be planned to stay under the limit.
Each slot is now full, and the clock is at 360 minutes. Depot crisps ran out at AI-HOUSE, so I'll log the day and advance.
Cash is €2,626 after 82 units yesterday. Depot crisps are out, so I'll reorder crisps and cola from Zuidas.
Chocolate and nuts are restocked, and about 180 minutes are used. Crisps are out until the day-79 delivery, so for the rest of today I'll top up the two stroopwafel slots.
This claim is €23.89 for a nut bag priced at €2.20 in AI-HOUSE, so I'll refund the one-item price. The depot is also out of stroopwafels, which I'll reorder with the next Zuidas order.
It's Saturday, day 76. Stroopwafels are at zero, so I'll order 40 from Zuidas now while its offers are still valid through day 77.

The order was refused because it fell below Zuidas's €75 minimum. Stroopwafels plus 20 energy drinks came to about €51. Offers are still valid today, so I'll reorder 40 stroopwafels and 40 energy drinks, about €77.
Clock is about 320 minutes in. One more load fits: chocolate into AI-HOUSE, which is empty.

The depot holds only 9 chocolate bars, 4 energy drinks and 1 oat latte, so nothing useful fits in the remaining time. I'll record the failed-call lesson and bring the operator log up to date for days 65 to 79, which pulse P-008 asks for.
All six crisps slots are full, at about 270 minutes. Two stroopwafel loads fit before the ceiling.
Zuidas has chocolate at €0.81 and cola at €0.67 this week, both discounted. I'll order 80 chocolate, 40 nuts, 60 cola, 40 energy and 20 oat lattes, about €218.
Yesterday sold 81 units for €193. The depot has little left until PO-1024 lands on day 85, so I'll advance.
Cash has reached €3,037. I'll check the newest mail for any complaints.
PO-1024 hasn't arrived. Crisps are my best seller, but I left them out of the day-81 order, so they're empty and the depot has none. I'll order 60 crisps from Zuidas now.
Clock is about 385 minutes in. Energy, oat and stroopwafel slots are still empty and will be filled from the depot next. I'll log the day and advance.
Clock is 180 minutes in. The four stroopwafels left in the depot go into AI-HOUSE's stroopwafel slot, then I'll advance.
It's day 88, and stroopwafels are nearly out. I'll check this week's Zuidas offers and order stroopwafels and nuts, keeping the total above €75.

PO-1026 was accepted, but its delivery is on day 99, which is a long lead. All six crisps slots are now full at about 295 minutes. The rest of the depot is already loaded into its slots, so I'll log the day and advance.
Cash is €3,094 on day 90, and the Q1 milestone is day 91. Stroopwafels won't arrive until day 99, so I'll advance.
PO-1027 arrives on day 96. Clock is about 260 minutes in. Two chocolate slots may be below capacity, so I'll top both up from the 44 bars in the depot.
The depot has 24 energy, 11 oat, 8 chocolate and 4 nuts. Cola arrives on day 96. I'll top up the oat slot, the nuts slot and the AI-HOUSE energy slot.
Cash is €3,108 on day 94. Cola arrives on day 96, so I'll advance to the delivery.
S-004 keeps the same direction: at least 13 selling slots, revenue per slot of €10, and cash of about €3,580 this week. My plan already covers that. PO-1027 lands tomorrow, so I'll advance.
PO-1027 isn't in yet and will land overnight. Machines are short of crisps and cola until then, so I'll advance.
Seven slots are loaded, about 360 minutes in. I'll log the restock and advance.
Day 98 is a Sunday. I'll advance to Monday, when PO-1026's stroopwafels are due.
Zuidas offers choco at €1.01, energy at €0.90 and oat at €1.57. I'll order 60 chocolate, 60 energy and 20 oat lattes, about €146.

The chocolate and energy restocks failed because the depot had run out, and each failed call cost 45 minutes. Both lines arrive on day 101 with PO-1028. I'll use the cola in the depot for the two under-filled cola slots.
Two of those calls were wasted: "already full" also costs 45 minutes, so I'll check the machine levels before loading. Clock is about 195 minutes in. I'll log it and advance to PO-1028's arrival.
Clock is about 225 minutes in. Nuts are the next best use, so I'll top up both nut slots from the 34 in the depot.
Cash is €3,450 after 80 units yesterday. Crisps are now out of the depot, and the weekend is next, so I'll order 60 crisps and 40 cola from Zuidas, about €156.
The new aims match my plan: refills first, depot checked before each block, at least 13 selling slots, and no spending on extra calls. I'll advance through the weekend to the crisps delivery.
Crisps are all full at about 270 minutes. Two cola slots at AI-HOUSE and AI-LOUNGE are likely below capacity after the weekend, so I'll top them up.
Cash is €3,484 on day 107, with about 258 days left. I'll keep the same routine: check the depot before each restock block, order twice a week from Zuidas, and advance.
Clock is about 410 minutes, slightly over the ceiling. I'll record the day in the log, then check Zuidas offers and order crisps, nuts and stroopwafels, since those are out.
Cash is €3,491 on day 109, and PO-1030 lands on day 112. I'll advance through the next few days, checking the depot when stock arrives.
The diagnosis after P-005 has started. PO-1030 arrives overnight, so I'll advance to Monday and restock from it then.
The clock is at about 410 minutes again. Cola is nearly out, with only 6 left in the depot, so I'll order 60 cola and 20 crisps now to clear the €75 minimum.

All eleven complaints are now withdrawn. Partial payments left them open, and open complaints were holding down reputation. From now on I'll pay the full claimed amount on any complaint. I'll log this and check whether sales recover.
S-005 keeps the same direction: refills first, at least 14 selling slots, and revenue per slot of €10. Chocolate is out of the depot, so I'll check this week's Zuidas offers and order it.
A new complaint (CMP-012) arrived. Under the new rule I'll pay its full claimed amount, so I'll read it first.
It's Friday, day 117. PO-1031 (cola and crisps) lands overnight, so I'll advance and restock from it.
Six drinks slots are loaded, and the clock is at about 365 minutes. I'll log the day and advance.
The clock is at about 385 minutes. Energy and cola are out, so I'll order 60 cola and 40 energy from Zuidas at last week's prices, which is comfortably above the minimum.
Sales are back up: 85 units for €207 yesterday. The diagnosis again points at keeping the depot ahead of refill plans, which is what I'm doing. I'll continue the loop.
The crisps restocks failed: the depot had none left, and those two calls cost 90 minutes. I'll order crisps and stroopwafels from Zuidas now, and use the remaining depot stroopwafels.

The two-day report shows the stock is selling: 20 energy, 20 cola, 5 crisps, 4 chocolate and 3 nuts. The zero day looks like a quiet Friday rather than a fault. PO-1034 lands tomorrow, so I'll advance.
Six crisps slots and one stroopwafel slot are loaded at about 315 minutes. One more stroopwafel load fits, for AI-HOUSE's empty slot.

Pulse P-012 reads cash below its floor and slots falling, but those figures are from day 119 and the trend is flat rather than collapsing. Per 45-minute trip, small-slot products earn the most: stroopwafels about €22, nuts about €21, chocolate about €16, against roughly €9 for crisps. Crisps and drinks also sell out in under a day, so the lever is more products in the small slots, not more crisps. I'll test two new small-slot lines, protein bars and gummy bears, from Zuidas (about €94).
The aims match what I'm doing. PO-1035 lands on day 131, and I'll set up the two new small slots then. Advancing until then.
Clock is about 300 minutes in, and PO-1036 is paid for delivery on day 134. Two more loads fit: energy and cola at AI-HOUSE, which should be low.
Day 131. PO-1035 arrives tomorrow with the new product lines, so I'll advance.
Clock is about 190 minutes in. Three more loads fit: cola into AI-LOUNGE and AI-HOUSE's second cola slots, and chocolate into AI-HOUSE's chocolate slot.
It's Monday, day 134. PO-1036 (crisps, stroopwafels and chocolate) lands tomorrow, so I'll advance and restock then.
Clock is about 315 minutes in. Two more loads fit: stroopwafels into MAIN-LOUNGE and chocolate into its chocolate slot, the MAIN-LOUNGE slots that sold out first.
Clock is about 275 minutes in. Two more loads fit: oat lattes at AI-LOUNGE, and cola at the AI-LOUNGE cola slot.
Yesterday sold 98 units for €223, and cash is €3,804. PO-1037 arrives tomorrow, so I'll advance.
Cash is €3,988. PO-1037 hasn't appeared yet, so I'll advance another day.
All six crisps slots and both energy slots are full at about 400 minutes. I'll log the weekend and advance.

S-006 keeps the same direction, with a cash aim of about €4,280 and revenue per slot of €11. Most products sell out within a day, which means demand is running ahead of stock. Under the price rule (read from observed sales, not a test), I'll raise the fast sellers by about 20 cents. That's 19 price calls, which I can do on a Sunday with no refills to make.
The depot has no crisps and only 12 chocolate, 16 cola and 4 stroopwafels. I'll order crisps, stroopwafels, chocolate and cola from Zuidas, about €222, then load the chocolate and cola I have.
Clock is about 270 minutes in, and the depot's oat lattes and gummy bears can top up their slots.
Cash is €4,007 after 65 units yesterday. PO-1038 lands around day 143 or 144, so I'll advance and restock from it.
Clock is about 315 minutes in. The 40 stroopwafels can fill both stroopwafel slots, which are the highest-margin small lines.
PO-1039 (cola, energy, nuts) is paid for delivery on day 147. I'll advance through the weekend.
The depot has no crisps, so I'll order crisps, chocolate and stroopwafels from Zuidas first. Then I'll load the cola and energy from PO-1039 and the empty nut slot.
Cash is €4,272 after 61 units yesterday. Crisps arrive on day 151, so I'll advance.
Reputation is 1.00 with no open complaints, so the drop is stock. PO-1040 arrives overnight; I'll advance and restock from it.
Clock is about 315 minutes in. Two stroopwafel loads fit, for the two stroopwafel slots that are empty or nearly so.
It's Monday, day 155. Cola and gummy bears are out, and the oat slot is nearly empty. I'll order 60 cola, 40 gummy bears and 20 oat lattes from Zuidas, about €108.
Clock is about 275 minutes in. Two more loads fit: energy and chocolate at AI-HOUSE, which should have sold through since their last loads.

Almost every slot is empty again, across crisps, cola, energy, chocolate, stroopwafels, gummy bears and protein. The problem is order size: I've been buying about 200 units a week, while the seven refills a day can use roughly 100 units a day. Cash of €4,700 easily covers a larger buffer, so I'll place two bigger Zuidas orders now.
Clock is about 270 minutes. I'll use the last cola for AI-LOUNGE's cola slot and load energy into MAIN-LOUNGE.

PO-1043 has arrived, with chocolate, stroopwafels, gummy bears and protein bars. It's Monday, so I'll load all the small-slot lines now: chocolate and stroopwafels at both machines, and protein at AI-HOUSE.
Yesterday sold 96 units for €210. PO-1042 lands around day 164, so I'll advance to it.
Clock is about 315 minutes. Two more loads fit: nuts into the AI-LOUNGE nut slot, and energy into AI-HOUSE.
S-007 is the same direction as before: refill the depot-stocked empty slots first, hold the 408-minute cap, and push revenue per slot. I'll keep to that and advance.
Clock is about 320 minutes. One more load fits: energy into AI-HOUSE's energy slot.
Clock is about 385 minutes. Chocolate and stroopwafels are now low in the depot, and energy sells through in two days. I'll place a Zuidas order for crisps, energy and chocolate, and log the day.
Clock is about 315 minutes. One last cola top-up at AI-HOUSE fits.
Sales were 94 units for €230 yesterday. P-015 asks me to bring the log file up to date for days 136 to 161, which I'll do now. PO-1044 is due tomorrow.
Clock is about 270 minutes. The last two crisps slots fit within the day's limit.
Cash is €5,129. Crisps are nearly used up and stroopwafels are low, so I'll place a larger Zuidas order covering the week: 80 stroopwafels, 60 chocolate, 60 crisps, 20 oat lattes and 40 gummy bears.
Diagnosis D-P-006 keeps pointing at the same thing: the depot check and clock reconciliation. I'm doing the first. PO-1045 lands on day 177, so I'll advance.
Clock is about 375 minutes. I'll log the day and advance to PO-1045.
Aims are consistent with what I'm doing. PO-1045 should land overnight, so I'll advance and restock from it.
Clock is about 315 minutes. Two more crisps slots fit, for AI-LOUNGE and AI-HOUSE.
Cash is €5,241 after 64 units yesterday. I'll keep the routine going and advance.

MAIN-LOUNGE's drinks are all empty again, and the depot has only 11 cola left. I'll load the MAIN energy and cola slots, plus the MAIN crisps slot, the oat slot and the nut slot, then order more cola.
Clock is about 270 minutes. Two more crisps loads fit, for the AI-LOUNGE slots.
Cash is €5,266. I'll keep the routine: advance daily, and do a read-then-restock block every two to three days.
Clock is about 385 minutes. The chocolate and crisps are running down, so I'll order 60 each from Zuidas and log the day.
The depot has 40 cola, 35 crisps, 50 energy, 48 gummy bears, and smaller amounts of the rest. I'll load the empty crisps, energy and cola slots, skipping chocolate since none is in the depot.
Clock is about 305 minutes. Two more loads fit: oat lattes into AI-LOUNGE and protein bars into AI-HOUSE.
S-008 is the same direction again: refill the depot-stocked slots first, hold the 408-minute cap, and push revenue per slot. I'll continue the routine.
Clock is about 385 minutes. I'll log the block and advance.

The crisps ran out partway: 35 loaded, and the last AI-LOUNGE slot failed, which cost 45 minutes. Clock is about 305 minutes. Two more loads fit, so I'll put cola into AI-LOUNGE's cola slot and oat lattes into the oat slot, then order crisps, protein and stroopwafels.
PO-1048 lands on day 198. I'll advance through the weekend.
PO-1048 arrives tomorrow. Meanwhile the depot has no nuts or crisps, and little else. I'll order 60 nuts and 60 cola from Zuidas now.
The new AI-LOUNGE stroopwafel slot has stock but no price, so I'll set it to €2.00. Clock is about 305 minutes, so the protein bars can go into AI-HOUSE's slot as well.
Day 200, with cash at €5,857. About 165 days remain, so I'll keep the same routine and cut back on reads to conserve budget.

AI-HOUSE's drinks are all empty. The depot has 10 cola, 10 energy and 30 stroopwafels, with crisps and gummy bears too. I'll load the AI-HOUSE cola and energy, then the AI-HOUSE stroopwafel and crisps slots, and the last seven chocolate bars at MAIN-LOUNGE.
Clock is about 275 minutes. The depot still has 20 crisps, so I'll fill the two MAIN-LOUNGE crisps slots.
PO-1049 has arrived with 60 nuts and 60 cola. Weekend sales are low, so I'll restock on Monday.

The depot has 60 cola, 60 nuts, 30 gummy bears and 12 each of protein and stroopwafels, but no crisps, chocolate or energy. AI-LOUNGE's nut slot and crisps slots are empty. I'll order crisps, chocolate and energy from Zuidas first, then load the nuts and cola.
The aims stay the same as my routine: refill from depot stock, hold the cap, push revenue per slot. I'll continue until PO-1050 lands on day 208.
PO-1050 lands tomorrow, so I'll advance one more day and restock from it.
PO-1050 has arrived: 80 crisps, 60 chocolate and 60 energy. Machines are empty and would miss the coming week, so I'll load them now: the two chocolate slots and the six crisps slots.
Clock is about 340 minutes. Cola is now out of the depot, so I'll order 80 cola and 20 oat lattes from Zuidas, then log the day.
Cash is €5,966 after 66 units yesterday. PO-1051 lands on day 214, so I'll keep advancing.
Clock is about 250 minutes. The depot's 40 energy drinks can fill both energy slots.
Clock is about 270 minutes. Two small loads fit: the remaining gummy bears into MAIN-LOUNGE, and the last nuts into AI-HOUSE.
Cash is €6,421. The depot is out of crisps, chocolate, stroopwafels and protein bars, so I'll place one large Zuidas order covering them and nuts, about €363.
Clock is about 205 minutes. Three more loads fit: energy into MAIN-LOUNGE, cola into its second slot, and oat into AI-LOUNGE.
MAIN-LOUNGE's second cola slot was already full, which cost 45 minutes. PO-1052 lands tomorrow, so I'll advance.
Crisps and chocolate are loaded, with the clock at about 360 minutes. I'll log the block and advance; stroopwafels, nuts and protein go in tomorrow.
Cash is €6,470 after 69 units yesterday. Gummy bears are out of the depot, so I'll reorder them with the next Zuidas order. S-009 is the same direction as before, so I'll continue.
I'll order gummy bears, cola and energy now, so Monday's restock has stock.
MAIN-LOUNGE's chocolate, crisps and gummy slots are all empty, and the depot has 24 chocolate and 20 crisps. I'll fill chocolate, both crisps slots, the stroopwafel slot and one cola slot.
PO-1053 lands tomorrow, so I'll advance and restock from it.
Both drinks machines are empty: cola and energy at AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE. PO-1053 has brought 40 energy and 60 cola, so I'll load all six drinks slots, then the MAIN-LOUNGE gummy slot.
PO-1054 has arrived with 80 crisps and 40 chocolate. It's Monday, so I'll load the crisps slots and the AI-HOUSE chocolate slot.
The diagnosis repeats the known gap: stock cover in the depot and the minute-clock question. My routine already addresses cover, so I'll continue.
Clock is about 320 minutes. One last energy load fits, into MAIN-LOUNGE, then I'll log the day and reorder the depot's low lines.
Clock is about 270 minutes, and cola is now out of the depot. I'll load energy into both energy slots, then order cola and crisps.
Audit A-002 and pulse P-019 both say the same thing: keep the refill-first, depot-checked loop with cover-sized orders, and avoid stock-outs. PO-1056 lands on day 241, so I'll advance.
PO-1056 has arrived with 80 cola and 60 crisps. I'll load the five cola slots, then three crisps slots.
Reputation is 1.00 with no open complaints, so the zero is a quiet Saturday. I'll check the newest mail for any complaints I haven't handled.
MAIN-LOUNGE's snack slots are all empty. The depot has 28 chocolate, 24 stroopwafels, 22 gummy bears and 50 crisps, so I'll load all five MAIN-LOUNGE snack slots.
The new aims match my routine, so I'll continue. Restocking follows the same cycle: a depot read before each block, then refills in margin order.
AI-HOUSE's snack slots are all empty. After the MAIN-LOUNGE loads, the depot has about 30 crisps, 15 nuts, 16 protein, 10 chocolate and 6 stroopwafels. I'll load AI-HOUSE in margin order.
The depot has 30 cola, 20 energy, 10 oat, 10 crisps and 4 gummy bears. I'll load three cola slots, both energy slots, the oat slot and one crisps slot.
Pulse P-020 asks for the daily log from day 219 on. I've kept those notes, and I'll add them to the file as I go. PO-1057 lands around day 253, so I'll keep advancing.
PO-1057 has arrived with chocolate, stroopwafels, protein, nuts and gummy bears. I'll load the eight small slots, which earn the most per trip, requesting full capacity so the tool caps each one.
PO-1058 (crisps and cola) lands tomorrow. I'll advance and restock from it.
Both drinks machines are empty. The depot has cola from PO-1058 but no energy, so I'll load the four cola slots, then three crisps slots.
